name: hud_sensor_tracker_find_and_highlight_first_incomplete_objective
description: HudSensorTracker::FindAndHighlightFirstIncompleteObjective returns the first incomplete objective index and enables its map marker in blue. Direct production host: mission.cpp.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to a coherent HudSensor objective/map source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x418c30 validates objectiveCount at tracker offset 0x12c, objectiveSlots base at offset 0x53c, 0x31c-byte objective slot stride, completedFlag scan from index 0, SetObjectiveMarkerEnabledAndColor(index, 1, blueRgb24) for the first incomplete objective, and objectiveCount return when all active objectives are complete.

The native HudSensor smoke verifies first-incomplete index selection, blue marker enabling for the matching map node, nonmatching marker preservation, and objectiveCount return when all objectives are complete.
